title: Newly Established Bed & Breakfast Equity Stake For Sale in Itacaré, Brazil
tagline: An upcoming eco-tourism and sustainable retreat business will be developed on a 26-hectare (approximately 64-acre) privately owned property in Itacaré, Bahia, Brazil, offering a unique opportunity to establish a nature-focused hospitality destination. - The property comprises 20 hectares of pristine Atlantic Rainforest and 6 hectares of thriving cacao and fruit orchards, making it suitable for eco-tourism, sustainable agriculture, and nature-based retreats. - It features several natural attractions, including a private waterfall, a main stream, and two smaller creeks, providing opportunities for relaxation and outdoor recreational activities. - Existing accommodation infrastructure includes a main house with double verandas, a cozy sunroom, and several bedrooms, along with a fully furnished guest cottage offering stunning views. - The property also benefits from advanced infrastructure, including custom underground power and high-speed internet utilities, ensuring reliable connectivity without overhead utility lines. - A well-constructed water tower and a separate drinking water well provide a stable water supply for the property and its planned hospitality operations. - To expand the tourism offering and increase accommodation capacity, plans are in place to construct five additional cottages. - All land documentation and building permits are in place, providing a foundation for the planned development. - The property presents an opportunity to establish an eco-tourism and sustainable retreat destination that combines accommodation, rainforest surroundings, cacao and fruit orchards, and natural water features.
